mentions.name: Feedbee
mentions.description: A simple, reusable feedback collector that can be dropped into any project instead of rebuilding one each time. Includes a dashboard, feedback clustering, and automated pull requests generated by Claude Code.
mentions.problem: The author ends up rebuilding a feedback collector in every project.
mentions.source_excerpt: Simple feedback collector. Something I end up building in every project, so why not built it once and productise even just for myself. Still building out the dashboard, some clustering, and automated PRs (by Claude Code)
